notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40938121/b4f2859975d8c36bc74f2c5d1a1230bd57b0e890.png

Bugs

 Fixed minor bugs
 Improved some rematch events
 Test tubes damage was influenced by INT, instead of OFF


Gameplay

 Introduced three Game Modes: Story, Standard and Challenge
 Story focuses on the plot, with far easier battles
 Standard focuses on both story and battles (build 1.0.0 difficulty)
 Challenge focuses on battles and knowledge of the game features. Extra money and Lusts will be gained during this mode


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40938121/1aa9f14b40d56e61fb59ef8128f32b4d149ca75c.png


 A new event and related boss fight after The End of Good Ending, on Challenge Mode
 Introduced the New Game+ feature
 Added two new trophies
 Improved overall monsters' behavior, statistics rebalanced and added more different skill effects depending on game mode
 Graphical improvements, such as new icons for monsters and Pains
 Save interface improved, now displaying playtime, money and chapters completed
 File load and deletion are now available in save points
 Added a save point in Emporium, during Final Chapter
 Important choices selection, like save points and rematches, improved


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40938121/287c9c4c1000822e0f68e8fc62795039100032e1.png


 Characters crit chance slightly improved
 Combo deals slightly more damage
 Anne's Test Tube+2 now has a chance to decrease Pain resistance, instead of increasing odds.
 Canes and Test tubes now specify that the damage dealt scales with enemy's RES
 Some important plot sentences are now highlighted in pink


New Game +

 A NG+ save point appears after completing Bad or Good Ending
 NG+ carries over collected cards
 Story events will be skippable
 Full OST will be playable by talking to Undreamed band
 Optional choice to carry over side-quests progress
 A new scene with Alexis


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40938121/a07aa1e153881b4c841728644a37cbe8b71573ad.png

Strategy Guide DLC will also be updated, with six new pages focused on Story, Challenge and the new boss battle.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 available now!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear inhabitants of Gris!
Thanks to your feedback, we're ready to release a first big game's update full of improvements.

Build 1.0.1 new features:

Fixes:
- Minor typo errors adjusted
- Minor graphic improvements
- Some few sentences and enemy abilities were not translated in Italian
- Fixed a little issue with theater headlights, while choosing chapters
- Judgement's scale texts adjusted, in Arthur's 4th chapter
- Ammit's card name now appears after her defeat, when talking to Zzem
- Undertaker's riddle 2nd and 3rd retries have been adjusted, in Michael's 4th chapter

Adds:
- Some waiting times between events are now shorter, like in the Theater
- Loading image Take a seat... replaced by a pink Loading... image
- E key tutorial, for Options and Back to Title menu, is now explained in the Introduction Chapter
- After pressing E, you'll also be able to read a complete list of the game's tutorials. Those will be unlocked while playing
- Cathrine can now enter the basement directly, from 2nd Chapter onward
- Alexis can now enter the Shop of Wishes directly, in Final Chapter
- Requested items delivered to the Duke are now marked with an V, while talking to him
- After delivering 8 items, the Duke tells you that >
- The Duke's walking stick now appears during event in Emporium
- Card read is faster, and list begins from n. 1
- Power-up menus ask you directly which character do you want to strengthen
- Before Lusts' sacrifice, power-ups now describe: number increases for stats; new effects for abilities 
- Maxed out stats and abilities now have a related message after last power-up
- Maxed out stats and abilities will now disappear from selection list, in both Tsed and Inis menus. Maxed character's names are disabled, but viewable in a dark gray
- Tsed will describe you statistics' purposes through a small tutorial, if you ask him to
- Completed story arcs now are disabled (character's name is in gray) from selection list, in the Domlion Theater

Patch is available NOW!
